name: cssquake
description: A standalone CSS-rendered Quake renderer powered by PolyCSS.

scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm prepare:quake && vite build
scripts.trace:quake: node scripts/chrome-trace/trace.mjs generic --url http://127.0.0.1:5173/ --ready-js "document.querySelectorAll('.polycss-mesh').length > 0" --action wait --sample 3000 --summary-out bench/results/quake/idle-summary.json --trace-out bench/results/quake/idle.trace.json --report --markdown-out bench/results/quake/idle.md
